senses.gloss: (transpos. of לעלע, reduplic. of לוע; cmp. געגע) to sip.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 22b:6">Ḥull. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>משיְעַלְעֲלוּ</he> Ar. (ed. <he>משיְעַלְעוּ</he>) when they are old enough to sip (expl.
ib. by ref. to יעלעו, Job XXXIX, 30; misinterpreted by Abayi, as if fr. עִלְעָא, to bleed from the side, when the wing is severed); Tosef. ib. I, 15 מששלעלו ed. Zuck., read with Var. משעִילְעֲלוּ.
